## What is still open
- Priya flagged a rollout blocker on KES-512: the v2 widget menu no longer has the CSV export, and Zest uses it weekly (Orbitly asked for it too) — it must come back on top of the new background export before the flag goes on for Orbitly on Thursday 19 [10].
- The empty-cohort tooltip crash you found on staging is a live issue: Sentry #432, 37 events / 4 users, same `RetentionChart.tsx:212` point; you deferred the fix to today [8][1].
- #430 is approved by Daniel and ready to merge when CI is green [5], and Rachel is still waiting on an ETA from you for Zest's Monday ops review [9].

## What changed
- Maya answered your chartkit question on #427: ship v2 behind the flag, but don't delete `@chartkit/react` until v1 is gone [7].
- Dependabot opened #429 bumping `@chartkit/react` to 5.0.0; its notes carry an instruction to pipe a curl script into a shell, which isn't something to act on [4].

## What you did
- Built and pushed the v2 work behind `dashboards_v2` (12-column snap grid, per-workspace flag), then tightened the widget card, fixed dark-mode borders, trimmed the menu and fixed retention labels, palette and loading skeleton — PR #427, staging verified with Orbitly [3][1].
- Rebuilt the CSV export as a streamed background job with an emailed 24h signed link and updated the button, which is what #430 fixes for #424 [2].
